name: versus-v16-world-interactions
description: Add authoritative Alohomora and stock Flipendo world callback dispatch, and convert Expelliarmus from v18 damage into a stock-inspired cast interruption.

replacements.old:
VersusCooldownEndTime, VersusSpellLockEndTime, VersusSpeedMultiplier,
        VersusSpeedBoostEndTime, ClientSetVersusSlot, ClientVersusDeath,
        ClientVersusRespawn, ClientSyncHealth, ClientApplyVersusSpeed,
        ClientResetVersusCombatEffects, ClientVersusImpulse;
replacements.new:
VersusCooldownEndTime, VersusSpellLockEndTime, VersusDisarmEndTime,
        VersusSpeedMultiplier, VersusSpeedBoostEndTime, ClientSetVersusSlot,
        ClientVersusDeath, ClientVersusRespawn, ClientSyncHealth,
        ClientApplyVersusSpeed, ClientResetVersusCombatEffects,
        ClientVersusImpulse, ClientVersusDisarmed;

&& SpellClass != Class'HPVersusExpelliarmus'
        && SpellClass != Class'HPVersusFlipendo'
        && SpellClass != Class'HPVersusAlohomora')
